identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.07][defect] Support quorum fencing and restart-safe lease epochs

values.task_boundary: Repair only quorum fence/revoke possession, next-epoch fencing, and portable restart-floor semantics in the existing lease authority implementation.
deliverables: Majority Fence/Revoke without old holder key
Focused positive and machine-derived negative tests
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Majority Fence and Revoke do not require the old holder activation key while holder-authorized operations still do.
AC-2: Fence commits exactly the next epoch and newer applied index; stale, same, and skipped epochs fail atomically.
AC-3: Fenced mutation is denied and snapshot/restore at current membership index preserves the fence and portable floor.
AC-4: Replacement activation before the portable safety deadline is denied after restart and succeeds only at the safe deadline with a valid new key.
AC-5: Exact nonzero tests, strict focused Clippy, machine-derived receipt validation, independent review, and CI pass.
dependencies: Legacy WP-04.08 issue #5870 remains unbound until this defect merges
non_goals: Module registration, lib.rs, mod.rs, Cargo, manifest, or lockfile changes
